source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Strongbow Twins-Pass heavy yak-wool tapestry brocade: interlocking octagonal medallions (three across and three down) woven in charcoal-basalt (#282a30) and pomegranate-madder (#7c2624) framing paired snow-capped black volcano cones (Al-Qaranan) and crossed notched bone Split-Tally staves in frost-cream (#ece8dc) and turquoise (#28a4a8), bordered by sulfur-cairn saffron (#e0a030) step-frets, whole octagons clear of seams. Full colour.
